column4: Merseyside derby at Anfield. Mohamed Salah scored a late winner in the 89th minute.
At the Etihad. Erling Haaland scored a hat-trick. Arsenal were thrashed.
London derby at the Emirates. Martin Ødegaard scored; Cole Palmer equalised late with penalties practised all week.
Everton, nicknamed the Toffees. Home ground: Hill Dickinson Stadium.
